integrity: Complete elementary free-face collapse is proved for every finite core digraph; 24 finite examples independently replay exact removals. Bibliographic priority is best-knowledge and not guaranteed globally.
scientific_limitations: Requires every core vertex to have one distinct leaf with both directions, loopless finite core, and the directed-linear-forest definition of a multipath; excludes single-orientation or partial whiskering and other arrow-complex conventions. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Bidirected vertex whiskering collapses every multipath complex to a cross-polytope sphere
